name: Livora
storyline:
In Livora, every life begins with possibility.

Create a character and shape their journey through choices that feel personal, meaningful, and real. Build relationships, manage responsibilities, pursue ambitions, face setbacks, and discover how everyday decisions can change the direction of a life.

From work, money, health, family, friendships, love, opportunity, loss, and success, each part of life connects to the next. Small choices can open new paths, test relationships, create consequences, or lead to unexpected moments of growth.

As time moves forward, your life becomes a unique story shaped by the decisions you make and the person you choose to become.

Livora is a modern life simulation about growth, consequence, resilience, and the many different ways a life can unfold.
summary: Livora is a browser-based life simulation strategy game about trying to build a stable life under modern pressure. Players choose a starting life and manage money, rent, bills, work, health, energy, relationships, family obligations, and long-term consequences. Every choice has a cost, and not every cost is money.
